name: MomoJoy
description: BLE HID gamepad host for ESP32-S3 on the Arduino core. Scans, bonds, parses the HID Report Map at runtime and decodes any BLE gamepad into a normalised state. Tuned for the ShanWan Q34U in Mode D (Android / BLE HID).
keywords: ble, hid, host, gamepad, joystick, esp32, esp32-s3, shanwan, q34u, nimble, robot
